# 鼻整形文献评点 · Rhinoplasty Daily Commentary

> 每天 3-5 条鼻整形（rhinoplasty）与面部提升（facelift）新文献的中英双语评点：每条一句事实、一句点评，附 PMID/DOI。数据源 Europe PMC（覆盖 MEDLINE/PubMed 与 PRS 等期刊）。可直接引用，注明来源即可。

## 2026-11-11

### Evaluation of Costal Cartilage Calcification Using Plain Radiographic Images
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- PMID: 42869429 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag222
- 事实: 183例鼻整形1098段肋软骨，平片钙化检出54.1%；重度钙化高峰在40–49岁。
- 点评: 术前一张肋骨平片能少一次台上意外；40多岁女性重度钙化风险最高，别只按年龄想当然。
- English: In 183 rhinoplasty patients (1,098 rib segments), plain radiographs detected costal cartilage calcification in 54.1%, with severe calcification peaking at age 40-49 (25.8%). A routine rib series avoids intraoperative surprises; women in their 40s carry the highest risk of severe calcification, not the oldest patients.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-11-pmid-42869429

### Does Previous Septoplasty Affect Rhinoplasty Outcomes? A Comparative Analysis of Functional, Psychological and Self-Assessment Measures
- 期刊: Journal of Clinical Medicine
- PMID: 42941334 | DOI: 10.3390/jcm15207819
- 事实: 75例鼻中隔鼻整形，27例曾做鼻中隔成形；术后6个月外观满意度更低，功能与生活质量仍改善。
- 点评: 有鼻中隔手术史的，外观预期要提前压低；功能该做还得做，别因既往史劝退。
- English: Among 75 rhinoseptoplasty patients, 27 (36%) had prior septoplasty and reported lower cosmetic satisfaction at 1 and 6 months, although nasal function and quality of life improved significantly. Lower the aesthetic expectation for prior-septoplasty patients, but do not let surgical history discourage a functionally indicated procedure.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-11-pmid-42941334

### Beyond Cartilage Grafting in Rhinoplasty: Biopharmaceutical and Biomaterial Strategies for Nasal Cartilage Regeneration
- 期刊: Life
- PMID: 42942299 | DOI: 10.3390/life16101713
- 事实: 叙述性综述：鼻软骨再生近期只能增强移植骨、修补小缺损，注射再生还替不了结构支架。
- 点评: 生长因子、外泌体、可注射水凝胶多在体外或关节数据；先当移植物辅助，别当卖点。
- English: This narrative review concludes that near-term nasal cartilage regeneration can enhance existing grafts and repair small contained defects, but injection-only regeneration cannot replace structural support. Growth factors, extracellular vesicles and injectable hydrogels remain largely in vitro or articular evidence; use them as graft adjuncts, not marketing claims.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-11-pmid-42942299

### Comparative Vector Analysis in Deep Plane Rhytidectomy: Evaluating Combined Horizontal and Oblique SMAS Fixation Strategies in Face and Neck Lifting
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42864533 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06377-y
- 事实: 80例深层除皱分4组：面部斜向+颈部水平固定，FACE-Q 88.4、WSRS改善2.4分，最优。
- 点评: 面颈别用同一个矢量：面斜拉、颈水平收，主观客观都更好；回顾性单中心，先学思路。
- English: In 80 deep-plane facelifts, oblique facial plus horizontal neck fixation scored highest (FACE-Q 88.4; WSRS improvement 2.4 points) versus three other vector combinations. Use different vectors for face and neck; the retrospective single-center design supports the concept, not a definitive standard.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-11-pmid-42864533

### Trends in Patient Profile and Surgical Preferences for Breast Augmentation in China: A Retrospective Cohort Study Before and After the COVID-19 Era
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42980684 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06410-0
- 事实: 682例中国隆胸：疫后更年长、假体更大（262.7对253.2cc）、圆型51.8%，满意度反降。
- 点评: 客人更懂、更敢花钱，不等于更满意；咨询重点从“做大”转到术后预期和长期形态。
- English: In 682 Chinese augmentation patients, the post-pandemic cohort was older, chose larger (262.7 vs 253.2 cc) and more round implants (51.8% vs 34.9%), yet breast satisfaction declined. Better-informed, higher-spending patients are not more satisfied; shift counseling from size to expectations and long-term shape.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-11-pmid-42980684

### Holidays With Perks: A Registry-based Study Investigating Revision Procedures Among Patients With Breast Implants Inserted Overseas
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
- PMID: 42910395 | DOI: 10.1097/gox.0000000000008147
- 事实: 30,579例假体翻修中11.7%为境外植入；境外组破裂27.0%、移位24.9%，均高于境内。
- 点评: 低价旅行隆胸的账最后算在翻修和公立医院上；接诊先问植入地、假体型号和原始记录。
- English: Of 30,579 breast implant revisions, 11.7% involved overseas-inserted devices, with higher rupture (27.0% vs 24.5%) and malposition (24.9% vs 20.5%). Cosmetic tourism shifts costs to revision surgery and public hospitals; ask overseas patients for implant records before planning.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-11-pmid-42910395

## 2026-11-10

### Design and Application of a Novel Device for Nasal Tip Flexibility and Stability
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42993309 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06390-1
- 事实: 自制装置测50名女性鼻尖四点，1.5N下位移8.6–11.2mm。
- 点评: 把鼻尖软硬度变成数字，方向有价值；但只有50例正常人、无术前术后对比，先当基线工具。
- English: A custom device measured four nasal-tip points in 50 young Chinese women under 1.5 N; mean displacement was 8.6–11.2 mm. Quantifying tip flexibility is useful, but 50 normal subjects without before-after surgery data make this a baseline tool, not evidence of clinical benefit.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-10-pmid-42993309

### Clinical Outcomes of Nasal Tip Infantile Hemangiomas: A Retrospective Cohort Study
- 期刊: Pediatric Dermatology
- PMID: 42978517 | DOI: 10.1111/pde.70258
- 事实: 58例鼻尖血管瘤：口服普萘洛尔者3岁时后遗症67.9%，未治者100%。
- 点评: 早用普萘洛尔，2mg/kg多半够；外用噻吗洛尔别拿来拖延口服治疗。
- English: In 58 infants with nasal-tip infantile hemangioma, propranolol was associated with fewer sequelae at age 3 (67.9% vs 100% untreated); low and high doses performed similarly. Start oral propranolol early at about 2 mg/kg/day, and do not let topical timolol delay it.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-10-pmid-42978517

### Assessing the Effectiveness of Bupivacaine for Managing Pain Post-rhinoplasty: A Triple-blinded Controlled Clinical Trial
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42864553 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06349-2
- 事实: 212例鼻整形：布比卡因表面+阻滞，镇痛药更少、恶心呕吐更低、满意度最高。
- 点评: II级证据；组合组省镇痛药、少恶心、满意度最高，表面组疼痛评分最低，按需选。
- English: In a triple-blind RCT of 212 patients, combined topical and nerve-block bupivacaine reduced analgesic use and postoperative nausea/vomiting and gave the highest satisfaction. Level II evidence supports combining topical and block bupivacaine; topical alone gave the lowest pain scores but did not reduce analgesic consumption.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-10-pmid-42864553

### Endoscopic Facelift with Isolation of the Fronto-Temporal Facial Nerve Branches: A Clinical Study of 300 Cases
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- PMID: 42872381 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag231
- 事实: 300例内镜拉皮，全程游离额颞支：无永久面神经损伤，暂时性额肌无力100%。
- 点评: 解剖清楚、可复制，代价是人人都暂时抬眉无力；单臂研究证明不了这买卖划算。
- English: In 300 consecutive endoscopic facelifts with circumferential isolation of the fronto-temporal branches, no permanent nerve injury occurred, but all patients had transient frontalis weakness; median recovery was 14 days. The technique is reproducible, but universal temporary brow weakness and the lack of a control group leave the risk-benefit trade-off unproven.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-10-pmid-42872381

### The Transumbilical Breast Augmentation: Safety and Satisfaction in a Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of 13,210 Breasts
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42993310 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06362-5
- 事实: 17项研究、13,210侧乳房：脐入路血肿0.2%、包膜挛缩1.7%、再干预2.3%。
- 点评: 数字漂亮，但几乎全是单臂回顾、随访短；适合极怕疤的人，不该当默认术式。
- English: A meta-analysis of 17 studies and 13,210 breasts found pooled TUBA rates of hematoma 0.2%, capsular contracture 1.7% and reintervention 2.3%, with high satisfaction but mostly retrospective single-arm data. The complication rates look excellent, but moderate bias and short follow-up make TUBA an option for scar avoidance, not a new default.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-10-pmid-42993310

### Five-Year Clinical Performance and Patient-Reported Outcomes of Mentor MemoryGel and MemoryShape Breast Implants (GLOW Study)
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- PMID: 42987925 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag234
- 事实: 5年随访：初次隆胸包膜挛缩MemoryShape 0.31%、Xtra 1.42%、普通圆型5.16%。
- 点评: 五年数据都算低，但研究没设计头对头，别拿这三个数直接排优劣。
- English: In the GLOW 5-year interim analysis, Baker III/IV capsular contracture rates in primary augmentation were 0.31% for MemoryShape, 1.42% for MemoryGel Xtra and 5.16% for MemoryGel non-Xtra; the study was not designed for direct comparison. All three rates are low, but without a head-to-head design the ranking is descriptive, not a reason to switch implants.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-10-pmid-42987925

## 2026-11-09

### "Dou-gong" Technique: A Novel Biomechanical Approach to Injection Rhinoplasty Based on Nasal Ligament Anatomy
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42897251 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06359-0
- 事实: 100例回顾：以鼻韧带为支点、骨膜上注射透明质酸，分五区，无血管栓塞。
- 点评: 把注射从堆量改成撑韧带，方向对；但100例无对照、无客观测量，只能算可行。
- English: In a 100-patient retrospective series, a five-zone "Dou-gong" technique injected hyaluronic acid above periosteum or perichondrium to reinforce nasal ligament support, with no vascular occlusion or material displacement. Shifting injection rhinoplasty from volume stacking to ligament support is conceptually right, but a single-arm Level IV series without objective measurement proves feasibility only.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-09-pmid-42897251

### Integrated Perioperative Infection Management Measures (PSMS-11) for ePTFE Rhinoplasty in East Asian Patients: A Large-Sample, Long-Term Retrospective Study
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42869968 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06292-2
- 事实: 1153例ePTFE鼻整形：感染率1.6%，过半发生在术后6个月以后，含1年以上迟发。
- 点评: 感染不看前三个月就漏一半；抽烟、翻修、皮肤炎症是术前能改的变量。
- English: Among 1,153 consecutive ePTFE rhinoplasties, overall infection incidence was about 1.6%, and more than half of infections presented beyond six months, including cases after one year. Late-onset infection is common rather than exceptional, so follow-up must extend past the first year and modifiable risks such as smoking and revision belong in preoperative planning.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-09-pmid-42869968

### Compromised nasal skin in functional rhinoplasty: a literature review and proposal of a clinical management protocol
- 期刊: Acta Otorrinolaringologica Española
- PMID: 42914090 | DOI: 10.1016/j.otoeng.2026.512413
- 事实: 综述：鼻皮肤坏死主因是翻修、吸烟、皮瓣过度打薄；早期硝酸甘油、高压氧、己酮可可碱可救。
- 点评: 真正该背的是风险清单和早期识别；等皮肤发黑再上药，多半只剩清创。
- English: A review identified revision surgery, smoking and aggressive flap thinning as the main risk factors for nasal skin necrosis, with early topical nitroglycerin, hyperbaric oxygen and pentoxifylline suggested for salvage. The protocol's value lies in preoperative risk stratification and early recognition; salvage drugs started after the skin turns black rarely change the outcome.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-09-pmid-42914090

### A Composite Internal Stabilization Strategy associated with Absence of Postoperative Hematoma After Facelift: A 561-Patient Comparative Series
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
- PMID: 42873118 | DOI: 10.1097/prs.0000000000013519
- 事实: 561例拉皮：内部止血网加渐进张力缝合，不放引流不加压，血肿清创0例，对照5.9%。
- 点评: 降到0靠的是消灭死腔不是压迫包扎；但面神经暂时麻痹10.4%，签字前得说。
- English: In a 561-patient comparative series, an internal hemostatic network with progressive tension sutures and no drains or compression produced zero hematomas requiring evacuation versus 5.9% in controls, with transient marginal mandibular weakness in 10.4%. Eliminating dead space beats external pressure for hematoma prevention, but a 10.4% transient nerve weakness rate is the price and belongs in consent.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-09-pmid-42873118

### When Does Grade I Ptosis Require Mastopexy? Implant-Only Augmentation in 198 Patients: A Clinical Framework for Patient Selection
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42897244 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06318-9
- 事实: 198例Ⅰ度下垂只放假体：翻修2例（1.0%），仅1人后来加做提乳，无包膜挛缩。
- 点评: Ⅰ度下垂不是提乳的自动指征；腺体量和组织厚度，比测量数据更能决定加不加疤。
- English: Of 198 women with Grade I ptosis selected for dual-plane augmentation alone, 1.0% were revised for superior malposition, one later chose mastopexy and none developed contracture. Grade I ptosis is not an automatic mastopexy indication; glandular volume, tissue quality and expectation alignment decide whether extra scars are justified.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-09-pmid-42897244

### Breast Implant Flipping: Prevalence, Clinical Correlation, and Independent Risk Factors in a Consecutive Ultrasound Cohort
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- PMID: 42886861 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag235
- 事实: 590例超声筛查：假体翻转12.7%，大体积、胸肌前、缺软组织覆盖是独立风险。
- 点评: 八个人里一个翻转，多数没症状；随访加个超声，比追问手感靠谱。
- English: In 590 consecutive patients screened with high-resolution ultrasound, implant flipping was found in 12.7%, independently associated with larger volume, prepectoral placement and lack of soft tissue support. One in eight implants is flipped, often silently; in-office ultrasound turns a vague complaint into an objective finding and belongs in routine follow-up.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-09-pmid-42886861

## 2026-11-08

### Accuracy of Navigated Osteotomies in Rhinoplasty: A Cadaveric Analysis
- 期刊: The Laryngoscope
- PMID: 42951306 | DOI: 10.1002/lary.71019
- 事实: 9具尸头18侧电磁导航截骨，实际截骨线与规划平均偏差1.5mm，经鼻与经皮入路无差异。
- 点评: 导航能把截骨做到亚毫米级，但尸头没出血没肿胀；真实价值在二次鼻和畸形鼻，不在常规截骨。
- English: In nine cadaver heads, 18 electromagnetically navigated osteotomies deviated from the planned nasomaxillary suture by a mean of 1.5 mm, with transnasal and percutaneous routes equally accurate. Sub-millimeter accuracy in a bloodless cadaver model proves feasibility, not superiority; navigation earns its cost in revision and distorted anatomy, not routine osteotomy.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-08-pmid-42951306

### Infraorbital versus sphenopalatine ganglion block for patient-reported recovery after septorhinoplasty: A randomized controlled trial
- 期刊: Journal of Clinical Anesthesia
- PMID: 42950360 | DOI: 10.1016/j.jclinane.2026.112354
- 事实: 90例鼻中隔鼻整形RCT：眶下神经阻滞24小时QoR-15为129.1分，蝶腭神经节阻滞116.6分。
- 点评: 眶下阻滞疼痛和恢复质量全面胜出，补救镇痛11%对53%；鼻整形术后镇痛该换默认选项。
- English: In a 90-patient RCT, ultrasound-guided infraorbital block beat transnasal sphenopalatine ganglion block on 24-hour QoR-15 (129.1 vs 116.6), with rescue analgesia in 11.4% versus 53.3%. The margin exceeds the minimal clinically important difference and cuts rescue opioid use fivefold; infraorbital block deserves to become the default for septorhinoplasty.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-08-pmid-42950360

### The V-Shaped Subdomal Graft: A Structural Template for Geometric Control of the Nasal Tip
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
- PMID: 42937516 | DOI: 10.1097/prs.0000000000013563
- 事实: PRS提出V形鼻小柱下移植物，用几何模板同时控制鼻尖宽度、高度与旋转。
- 点评: 把鼻尖控制做成模板，说明手感难复制；思路值得学，但一块移植物解决不了所有鼻尖。
- English: A PRS technique paper introduces a V-shaped subdomal graft as a geometric template for controlling tip width, height and rotation together. Template-driven tip surgery is valuable as a teaching scaffold, but it cannot replace diagnosing the underlying support deficit case by case.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-08-pmid-42937516

### Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42955309 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06392-z
- 事实: 9项研究的系统综述：AI测得减龄1.7–5.8岁，比患者自感年轻程度低35%–50%。
- 点评: 机器算出的岁数不能当疗效指标，患者照镜子那一眼才是；AI目前只能做辅助记录。
- English: Across nine studies, AI age estimation after facelift showed 1.7 to 5.8 years of reduction but underestimated patient-perceived rejuvenation by 35% to 50%. Systematic discordance with patient perception means AI-derived age is a research metric, not an outcome measure to quote in clinic.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-08-pmid-42955309

### Clinical Outcomes of Submuscular vs Subglandular Implant Placement in Primary Cosmetic Breast Augmentation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- PMID: 42969680 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag163
- 事实: 12项研究4534例：肌下/双平面总体并发症OR 0.49，包膜挛缩OR 0.58，血肿OR 0.30。
- 点评: 肌下赢在并发症，满意度和再手术率却没差别；腺体覆盖够的瘦病人，不必一刀切放肌下。
- English: Pooling 12 studies and 4,534 patients, submuscular or dual-plane placement had lower odds of overall complications (OR 0.49), contracture (OR 0.58) and hematoma (OR 0.30), with no difference in satisfaction or reoperation. Lower complication odds are real, but unchanged satisfaction and reoperation mean implant plane should follow tissue coverage, not habit.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-08-pmid-42969680

### Association of Ultrasound-Guided PECS II Block with Postoperative Pain Scores and Recovery Outcomes in Subpectoral Breast Augmentation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
- 期刊: Journal of Multidisciplinary Healthcare
- PMID: 42973786 | DOI: 10.2147/jmdh.s649678
- 事实: 48例胸肌下隆胸回顾：加PECS II阻滞后PACU疼痛评分1分对4分，无人需补救哌替啶。
- 点评: 样本小、回顾性，但差距大得不像偶然；把PECS II写进常规镇痛，成本低收益明确。
- English: In 48 subpectoral augmentations, adding a PECS II block cut PACU pain scores (median 1 vs 4) and eliminated protocol-driven rescue meperidine (0% vs 71.4%). Retrospective and small, but the effect size is too large to dismiss; PECS II is a cheap addition to standard multimodal analgesia.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-08-pmid-42973786

## 2026-11-07

### Septorhinoplasty: The Open Approach
- 期刊: Laryngo-Rhino-Otologie
- PMID: 42971217 | DOI: 10.1055/a-2903-7156
- 事实: 德国耳鼻喉科杂志刊出开放入路鼻中隔鼻整形专题，聚焦该入路的技术要点。
- 点评: 开放入路的价值在复杂病例的暴露与固定，不该当默认术式；条件允许时，闭合入路仍值得先考虑。
- English: A German ENT journal runs a focused piece on the open-approach septorhinoplasty and its technical points. The open approach earns its place in complex cases, not as a default; consider a closed approach first when anatomy allows.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-07-pmid-42971217

## 2026-11-05

### The V-Shaped Subdomal Graft: A Structural Template for Geometric Control of the Nasal Tip
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
- PMID: 42937516 | DOI: 10.1097/PRS.0000000000013563
- 事实: PRS 提出 V 形鼻尖下移植物，用一块可预判的软骨模板对鼻尖做几何化控制。
- 点评: 模板化的价值在于可复制，但要盯住鼻尖投影的长期稳定性——这类文章最常见的坑是随访短、样本小。
- English: PRS introduces a V-shaped subdomal graft as a predictable template for geometric tip control. Templates are only worth it if tip projection holds at 2+ years; check follow-up before adopting.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42937516

### Accuracy of Navigated Osteotomies in Rhinoplasty: A Cadaveric Analysis
- 期刊: The Laryngoscope
- PMID: 42951306 | DOI: 10.1002/lary.71019
- 事实: 九具尸体、18 侧电磁导航截骨显示，导航能让截骨线更贴近鼻上颌缝。
- 点评: 把「手感」变成可测误差是好事，但导航的机器成本和每台多出的 10 分钟，才是它进不了日间手术室的真实原因。
- English: Electromagnetic navigation placed osteotomies closer to the nasomaxillary suture in nine cadavers (n=18). Turning feel into a measured error is progress; capital cost and added setup time remain the adoption barrier.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42951306

### Infraorbital versus sphenopalatine ganglion block for patient-reported recovery after septorhinoplasty: a randomized controlled trial
- 期刊: Journal of Clinical Anesthesia
- PMID: 42950360 | DOI: 10.1016/j.jclinane.2026.112354
- 事实: 90 例随机对照：眶下神经阻滞 vs 蝶腭神经节阻滞，主要终点是术后 24 小时恢复质量。
- 点评: 这是能明天就改方案的那类证据——如果眶下阻滞不劣，操作更简单、超声引导更熟悉，值得换。
- English: A 90-patient RCT compared infraorbital with sphenopalatine ganglion block on 24-hour recovery quality. Actionable now: if infraorbital block is non-inferior, it is easier to teach and to schedule.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42950360

### Prevention of Secondary Deformities at the Donor Site After Cartilage Transplantation
- 期刊: Journal of Craniofacial Surgery
- PMID: 42980382 | DOI: 10.1097/SCS.0000000000013511
- 事实: 92 例耳软骨移植：术前耳模塑形 + 耳轮内侧切口，降低供区继发畸形。
- 点评: 供区畸形是患者术后最常抱怨却最少被写进论文的部分，这篇给了可照做的流程。
- English: In 92 patients, preoperative ear splinting plus antihelix-side incisions reduced donor-site deformity. Donor-site deformity is under-reported and over-complained about; this gives a repeatable protocol.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42980382

### Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- PMID: 42955309 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06392-z
- 事实: 系统综述纳入 9 项研究，评估 AI 判断提升术后年轻化的客观性与患者主观感知的一致性。
- 点评: 结论大概率是「AI 算得准、但和患者自己觉得好不好看不完全一致」——这正是咨询时最该讲的那句话。
- English: Nine studies reviewed on AI-based age estimation and its concordance with patient-perceived rejuvenation. Expect a gap between algorithmic age gain and patient satisfaction; that gap is the consultation script.
- Permalink: https://timsurg-boop.github.io/rhinoplasty-daily/#2026-11-05-pmid-42955309
